verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਅਨੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj jot udhot kar chaanan karai aner gavaae|

en.bdb: The sun with its bright rays dispels darkness and scatters light all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਜਗ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਸਭ ਸਨਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: kirat virat jag varatamaan sabh sanaba(n)dhan mukat karaae|

en.bdb: Seeing it the whole world gets engaged in business. The sun alone liberates all from the bondage (of darkness).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਿਰਗਾਵਲੀ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਲਾਉ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pas pa(n)khee miragaavalee bhaakhiaa bhaau alaau sunaae|

en.bdb: Animals, birds and the herds of deer speak in their loving tongue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਗਾਂ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਸਿੰਙੀਆਂ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਨੀਸਾਣ ਵਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: baa(n)gaa(n) buragoo si(n)n(g)eeaa(n) naadh baadh neesaan vajaae|

en.bdb: Qazis give call (azan) for prayer, yogis blow their trumpet (sringi) and at the doors of kings drums are beaten.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਾਇ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਝਥਿ ਵਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ghughoo sujh na sujhiee jai ujaaRee jhath valaae|

en.bdb: Owl does not listen to either of these and spends its day in a desolate place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਨ ਵਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun bhaau bhagat man bhau na vasaae|

en.bdb: Those who even listening to the word of the Guru in the holy congregation do not cultivate loving devotion in their heart, are manmukhs.
They spend their life in vain.
